scope: Public 50-tool catalog semantics plus truthful implementation/runtime/certification status metadata

root_causes.A-03: FastMCP tools were registered with tags only. All 50 public tools had description=null and annotations=null, forcing clients/models to infer semantics from names and global guide text.
root_causes.A-06: Runtime status and docs mixed current-session readiness, historical AutoCAD certification, implementation state and stale native-migration checkpoints. Historical PASS could not be distinguished cleanly from current-process evidence.

status_semantics.implementation: release_candidate + public_enabled separated from runtime readiness
status_semantics.runtime: platform_supported / connected / ready are current-process observations
status_semantics.certification: historical_primary_target_pass is evidence history only; current_process_certified remains false without bound provenance
status_semantics.release_match: current_release_match may become true after application detection but does not change current_process_certified
status_semantics.build_identity: provider/contract identity is exposed; source or DLL certification requires a separate runtime provenance manifest

verification.tdd_red_status: KeyError implementation before separated status schema was added
verification.focused_contract_and_com: 45 passed / 1 skipped on current tree before clean isolation
verification.linux_ruff_limit: No runnable Ruff binary is installed on the gateway Linux host; no Linux Ruff PASS is claimed. Windows locked Ruff is the lint authority for this candidate.

notes: Tool annotations remain advisory metadata and are not used for authorization or capability enforcement.
No historical evidence file was rewritten as current-process certification.
The public MCP surface remains exactly 50 tools; no capability was promoted by this task.
